coverage: Partial: two additional phone crop variants from other original captures. The ESP32 photograph has both outer contact rows. The ESP8266 photograph has 29 of 30 visible aliases; one ambiguous SO/S0 alias is deliberately excluded.
identity_policy: board -> photographed contact-row part -> visible contact with printed alias. Alias strings establish neither physical numeric pin numbers nor schematic nets. Repeated captures of the same physical specimen are correlated and must stay in the same train/validation fold.
